mapper.select: SELECT id,connection_id,task_code,batch_size,max_rows,active_run_id FROM int_base_sync_task WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND id=#{query.taskId} AND deleted=FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,connection_id,task_code,batch_size,max_rows,active_run_id FROM int_base_sync_task WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE ORDER BY task_code,id
SELECT id,preview,status,started_at FROM int_base_sync_run WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND task_id=#{query.taskId} AND id=#{query.runId} AND deleted=FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE int_base_sync_run SET status=#{command.status},read_count=#{command.counts.read}, inserted_count=#{command.counts.inserted},updated_count=#{command.counts.updated}, unchanged_count=#{command.counts.unchanged},deleted_count=#{command.counts.deleted}, error_message=#{command.error},finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{command.tenantId} AND task_id=#{command.taskId} AND id=#{command.runId} AND status='READING' AND deleted=FALSE
UPDATE int_base_sync_task SET active_run_id=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{command.tenantId} AND id=#{command.taskId} AND active_run_id=#{command.runId} AND deleted=FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT source_key,target_id,fingerprint FROM int_base_sync_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND task_id=#{query.taskId} AND object_key=#{query.object} AND deleted=FALSE AND source_key IN #{key} AND 1=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE int_base_sync_binding binding_row JOIN (VALUES ROW(#{row.tenantId},#{row.taskId},#{row.object},#{row.sourceKey},#{row.targetId},#{row.previousFingerprint},#{row.fingerprint},#{row.runId},#{row.actor})) incoming(tenant_id,task_id,object_key,source_key,target_id,previous_fingerprint,fingerprint,last_run_id,updater) ON binding_row.tenant_id=incoming.tenant_id AND binding_row.task_id=incoming.task_id AND binding_row.object_key=incoming.object_key COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND binding_row.source_key=incoming.source_key COLLATE utf8mb4_bin AND binding_row.target_id=incoming.target_id SET binding_row.fingerprint=incoming.fingerprint,binding_row.last_run_id=incoming.last_run_id,binding_row.updater=incoming.updater WHERE binding_row.deleted=FALSE AND binding_row.fingerprint=incoming.previous_fingerprint COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
